title: An integer overflow in the remote-control screen processing component of TeamViewer clients (Full Client, Portable and…
description: An integer overflow vulnerability exists in the remote-control screen processing component of TeamViewer clients (Full Client, Portable, and Remote Control App) prior to version 15.83. This flaw may allow a malicious remote host to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the viewer process. Exploitation requires a user to initiate a remote-control session to an attacker-controlled or compromised host.
